correctness.rationale: From independent one-sided endpoint ODEs a'=p(1-b), b'=q(1-a), a(0)=b(0)=0 recover H_p(t); conditioning k consecutive A attempts makes k-2 interior sites unconditionally accepted while the left/right exterior survival factors multiply, giving Q_k=H_p(t)^2(pt)^(k-2). Inclusion-exclusion Q_k-2Q_{k+1}+Q_{k+2} gives maximal cluster intensity H_p(t)^2(1-pt)^2(pt)^(k-2), including k=2, and geometric summation yields the cluster-count law; one-site survival on both sides gives the independently stated lambda_1. Factorial bound on decreasing-clock paths defines the infinite process and ergodicity converts event probabilities to spatial intensities. Independent exact rational color/order enumeration over all 3..5-site finite paths verified the k=2 boundary cylinder factorization at p=1/3,t=1, and the actual provided 3..7-site exhaustive checker was read; no finite check was treated as the infinite proof.
residual_risks: The conditional law starts only at size two and is cluster-count, not size-biased occupancy weighting; not an independence assertion for different clusters.
